verdict.rationale: Cal.com's v2 API documents a create-a-webhook endpoint where a programmatic consumer registers a subscriberUrl, chooses booking lifecycle triggers (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, payment events), and can set a custom payload template, with OAuth scope requirements stated. This is a genuine registrable outbound HTTP callback, not a chat-app integration. missing for 10: documentation of signing/verification secrets, retry and delivery semantics, and user- or org-level (vs. event-type) webhook scope, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: triggers: type: array items: type: string enum: - BOOKING_CREATED - BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED - BOOKING_PAID - BOOKING_RESCHEDULED - BOOKING_REQUESTED - BOOKING_CANCELLED
The template of the payload that will be sent to the subscriberUrl
If accessed using an OAuth access token, the `EVENT_TYPE_WRITE` scope is required.
